lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.21 - A Listen and number

details: Listen and number checks understanding of both time and activity vocabulary by having students number each image. Numbering supports sound–image association and strengthens recognition of activity words.
Look for careful listening and accurate numbering of each image.
“Oh no! Our days are all mixed up. I know the times and the activities, but I don’t know who does what, when! Can you listen carefully and help me number?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.21 - B. Listen and choose

details: Listen and choose develops listening comprehension by having students identify daily routine phrases through comparison with visual options. This supports understanding of time-of-day language.
Look for careful listening,  correct picture choices for each routine and consistent responses based on the audio.
“Ok, my day is starting to make sense, but I want to know more about what you do, and what she does! Can you help me listen and figure it out?”

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.77 - A Look and match

details: Look and match supports understanding of time expressions and activity vocabulary by linking written phrases to the correct images. Matching reinforces meaning and accurate recognition of familiar language.
Look for correct matching of times and activities, accurate recognition of clocks and activity pictures, and confident completion of the task.
“Uh oh, now I need to know what he and she do? Can you help?”

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.77 - B Look and write

details: Look and write develops reading and writing accuracy by guiding students to complete simple sentences about times and activities using visual prompts.
Look for correctly completed sentences that match the images, accurate use of time and activity vocabulary and mostly legible handwriting.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.22 - C. Listen and read

details: Listen and read develops listening and reading comprehension by helping students follow a text about times of the day and activities while hearing accurate pronunciation and reinforcing meaning through visual text support.
Look for careful listening, eyes tracking the text, accurate following of time expressions, and recognition of activity vocabulary as the story is read.
“Wow, what busy days you all have! Just hearing about your activities is making me sleepy!”

details: Choose the correct answers helps students with reading comprehension by having students identify accurate information about times of the day and activities.
Look for correct choices or written answers that match the text, clear links to time expressions and activities and neat, focused bookwork.
